$description: SplitView and ReadingPane (platform/patterns/SplitView; owner, 2026-10-16): two panels sharing their room, side by side or stacked, with a divider between (a line and a centered pill, the whole gap the target), and the reading pane's frame (the data table's).

split-view-gap.$description: The gap between the panels; the whole gap is the divider's target.

split-view-second-min-width.$description: Side by side: the second panel never gets narrower than this (under the split view's 900px they stack).

split-view-line-color.$description: The divider's line down the middle of the gap (the panels' frame color).

split-view-handle-color.$description: The pill centered on the line, at rest.

split-view-handle-hover-color.$description: The pill while the divider is hovered.

split-view-active-color.$description: Line and pill while the divider is focused or dragged.

split-view-handle-length.$description: The pill's length along the line.

split-view-handle-thickness.$description: The pill's thickness across the line.

reading-pane-background.$description: The reading pane's surface (the data table's).

reading-pane-border-color.$description: The reading pane's frame (the data table's).

reading-pane-border-width.$description: The reading pane's frame and the actions row's line.

reading-pane-radius.$description: The reading pane's corners (the data table's).

reading-pane-actions-gap.$description: Between the actions in their row.

reading-pane-actions-padding-block.$description: The actions row's room above and below.

reading-pane-actions-padding-inline.$description: The actions row's room at its ends.

reading-pane-rule-color.$description: The thin line under the actions.

reading-pane-rule-inset.$description: The line under the actions stops this far from each edge (owner: it does not touch the edges).
